commit.message:
fix(browser): dispatch returns proven agents to their task conversations (D-M4)

Live follow-up to the D-M3 deployment (35445466775.1): the click-select
replace gesture is correctly fail-closed on the root agent-task composer
(bounded single-append, no Enter on unverified text) but the live editor
also defeats the mouse selection - the account-synced draft kept growing
(28k chars across all four agent tabs) and task delivery stayed blocked.

The conversation composer is the surface that provably works end-to-end
(the supervisor wake lane runs on it continuously: key-atomic verified
replace + Enter submit). Every ACTIVE agent already owns a proven task
conversation (the /c/<uuid> from its first successful dispatch).

- fleet-provisioner-core: markTransportProven retains the exact
  conversation_url alongside the hash (the hash stays the proof binding)
- fleet-task-dispatcher: an agent with a proven conversation is dispatched
  IN that conversation - when the tab drifted off it (post-task bounce to
  root, restart), ONE bounded navigation (15s deadline, CONFIRMED-by-
  readback) returns it before any perception or typing; a failed
  navigation fails the dispatch before any effect
- first dispatches (BOUND_UNVERIFIED, no proof) keep the root flow - a
  freshly provisioned tab has a clean composer
- 4 new contract tests: drift navigation, at-conversation no-op, failed
  navigation fail-closed, unproven root flow

Full npm test: 2440/2438 pass/2 skip, zero fails.
